title: Contract Breadth Reduction for Reviewed Escalations (Contract Pricing Agreement)
content:
## Contract breadth reduction — Contract Pricing Agreement reviewed escalations

The breadth reduction follows the contract items the agreement carries, counted as its added item lines less its removal lines on the agreement's contract item records.

- 50 or more: 0.5 percentage point off.
- At least 25 and fewer than 50: 0.25 percentage point off.
- Fewer than 25: nothing taken off.

The points are taken off the reviewed escalation allowance — the lesser of the reviewed escalation increase and the tier's annual escalation cap — before the escalation line's prior unit price is raised by it, and the allowance never falls below 0.

Hypothetical example: 60 added item lines and 12 removal lines give 48 items carried, which takes 0.25 point off.
